entries.value: Explore the coastal district freely. Garage and harbor routes are open.

Walk to the garage, talk to the mechanic, get the sedan keys, and get inside the car.
Walk to the repair garage and talk to Marco.
Get into the parked sedan outside the garage.
Evening. Good timing — the sedan is tuned and fueled up.
Here are the keys. Harbor dispatch just called about an urgent spare-parts crate.
Hop in the sedan. Take the coastal road or cut through the back alleys if you know the turns.
Deliver the spare parts to the cargo harbor before time runs out.
Drive to the Cargo Harbor delivery bay before the timer expires.
Step out and speak with Elena at the harbor dock.
You made it before the shift cutoff. Drop the crate right here — thanks.
Wait a second before you leave. One of our cargo sedans never checked back in tonight.
Last anyone saw it, a dark sedan was parked somewhere inside the apartment blocks. Keep an eye out.
Search the apartment neighborhood on foot for the described car and find the next shipment address.
Follow the car leaving the harbor without losing sight or getting too close, then collect the dropped package.
Return to the neighborhood via either route and deliver the package to Marco or Elena.
